subject.title: refactor(canvas): promote inline-widget hosting and show_widget to core

question: Should core-owned `show_widget` remain covered by an operator’s existing `tools.deny: ["canvas"]` policy after this ownership promotion?
rationale: The branch describes a zero-behavior-change move, but its present registration changes a policy boundary; maintainers must explicitly reject that compatibility expectation before allowing a breaking alternative.

options.title: Preserve Canvas deny semantics
options.body: Keep `show_widget` core-owned while retaining its historical inclusion in the Canvas deny group and add focused regression tests.

options.title: Adopt a breaking policy split
options.body: Make `show_widget` independently configurable only with an explicit compatibility decision, migration or upgrade guidance, and revised policy documentation.

recommendation.title: Preserve Canvas deny semantics
recommendation.body: Keep `show_widget` core-owned while retaining its historical inclusion in the Canvas deny group and add focused regression tests.
